description:
[FREE] Live registry of the AgentPay universal x402 settlement rail. Every
facilitator resource can register a payee wallet and receive an automatic
on-chain share of each settled payment (gross minus a small fee, paid in USDC
on Base). Returns the registered payees with their resource prefixes, wallet,
status, totals (payments, gross, fee, net, paid) and disbursement history
with on-chain tx links. The facilitator index at
https://x402-agent-pay.com/facilitator exposes the same data for humans.
name: settlement_rail_info
